title: Duecare Chat Playground Wheels
subtitle: Baseline wheels for harness-OFF Gemma 4 chat - the failure mode that the harness fixes
description: v3.16 - wheels for the baseline chat-playground (harness OFF). Bundled: duecare-llm-chat / -core / -models.
